title: Bridge Task API 1.0.0-rc.1
description: Closed model-neutral transport contract. BoundCaller and grants are server-only. Internal deliver_result must not be exposed to model tools. Business evidence and authorization invariants are enforced by service.

Key.description: Stable intent key in server-bound principal/namespace generation; minimal intent digest tombstones persist for namespace lifetime after 90-day receipt-body expiry. Old revoked generations are never accepted or reused. Not a Bridge request ID. Namespace=(authority,stable_bound_scope,namespace_generation,path,operation,task_id-or-create). Same key across distinct tasks/stores is independent; within same namespace differing payload conflicts. Process/socket generation is NOT namespace generation.

Identity.description: Read projection only: missing historical identity fields are omitted, never filled with current revision or 0. New verified bindings require exact original server-validated identity in service.

Target.description: Compare constraint: native_thread_id/expected_native_thread_id is existing Bridge ResumeID (Codex thread ID or Claude provider session ID). Use typed provider mapper; never interpret a Claude ResumeID as Codex turn.

Profile.description: Full explicit triplet. Service supports only discovered compatible model/effort. Omitted new-worker profile resolves codex/gpt-6.1-sol/high.

Scope.description: Compared with effective original authorization; cannot grant new roots/tools/network. New worker read-only/default no recursive children.

Dependency.description: Pins immutable task definition/contract revision. State/event revisions may progress to satisfy required axes. Definition/scope/grant content changes invalidate the dependency.

LookupReceipt.description: Unambiguous canonical-store locator. Append/cancel/delivery keys are namespaced by task_id; create by server-resolved path. Caller stable scope/generation is server-bound and never client-selected.

DeliverInput.description: Internal service operation only; never model-callable. Source must exactly match original server binding.

Anchor.description: Canonical message anchor plus exact provider execution evidence; Claude tokens never masquerade as Codex turn IDs. Missing verifiable provider execution or canonical anchor means unanchored/unsupported.

Receipt.description: Namespace=(authority,stable_bound_scope,namespace_generation,path,operation,task_id-or-create). Same key across distinct tasks/stores is independent; within same namespace differing payload conflicts. Process/socket generation is NOT namespace generation.

revision.description: Monotonic state/event revision; mutation CAS uses this. Dependencies pin definition_revision instead.

Task.description: Legacy missing goal/scope/etc omitted; new v1 creates require all business fields. Service enforces sealed/delivered invariants.

ExactSourceIdentity.description: Compare constraint: native_thread_id/expected_native_thread_id is existing Bridge ResumeID (Codex thread ID or Claude provider session ID). Use typed provider mapper; never interpret a Claude ResumeID as Codex turn.

Cursor.description: Opaque integrity-protected scoped cursor; exact encoded byte cap enforced by codec.
